rationale: Adds asynchronous native alerts (NSAlert sheets), asynchronous open and save panels with a host-pluggable async backend, open_url limited to web and mail links, and teardown hooks on MainThreadScope so a dialog closes and drops its completion when its owner goes away. All additive and host-neutral, with no view or render dependency; the existing synchronous FileDialog calls are unchanged. The next Vellum re-export of core/platform should carry it.
